verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Foolish and inconsiderate men, who have neither wisdom nor instruction, mock and deride us, being eager to exalt themselves in their own conceits.
verses.modernizedText: Foolish and thoughtless men, who have neither wisdom nor instruction, mock and deride us, eager to exalt themselves in their own conceits.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: For what can a mortal man do, or what strength is there in one made out of the dust?
verses.modernizedText: For what can a mortal man do, or what strength is there in one made from dust?

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: For it is written, “There was no shape before mine eyes, only I heard a sound, and a voice [saying], What then?
verses.modernizedText: For it is written, “There was no shape before my eyes; I heard only a sound and a voice [saying], What then?

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Shall a man be pure before the Lord?
verses.modernizedText: Shall a man be pure before the Lord?

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Or shall such an one be [counted] blameless in his deeds, seeing He does not confide in His servants, and has charged even His angels with perversity?
verses.modernizedText: Or shall such a one be [counted] blameless in his deeds, since He does not trust His servants and has charged even His angels with perversity?

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: The heaven is not clean in His sight: how much less they that dwell in houses of clay, of which also we ourselves were made!
verses.modernizedText: The heavens are not clean in His sight; how much less those who dwell in houses of clay, from which we ourselves were also made!

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: He smote them as a moth; and from morning even until evening they endure not.
verses.modernizedText: He struck them like a moth, and from morning until evening they do not endure.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Because they could furnish no assistance to themselves, they perished.
verses.modernizedText: Because they could provide no help for themselves, they perished.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: He breathed upon them, and they died, because they had no wisdom.
verses.modernizedText: He breathed upon them, and they died because they had no wisdom.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: But call now, if any one will answer thee, or if thou wilt look to any of the holy angels; for wrath destroys the foolish man, and envy killeth him that is in error.
verses.modernizedText: But call now, if anyone will answer you, or if you will look to any of the holy angels; for wrath destroys the foolish man, and envy kills him who is in error.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: I have seen the foolish taking root, but their habitation was presently consumed.
verses.modernizedText: I have seen the foolish taking root, but their dwelling was quickly consumed.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: Let their sons be far from safety; let them be despised before the gates of those less than themselves, and there shall be none to deliver.
verses.modernizedText: Let their sons be far from safety; let them be despised before the gates of those lesser than themselves, and there will be no one to deliver them.

verses.book: The First Epistle of Clement to the Corinthians.
verses.text: For what was prepared for them, the righteous shall eat; and they shall not be delivered from evil.”
verses.modernizedText: For what was prepared for them, the righteous will eat, and they will not be delivered from evil.”
